Sandbox_DF_Enabled_tooltip: Master toggle. When disabled, the panel keybind does nothing and consumer mods that register tabs/actions sit idle. Designed for dedicated multiplayer servers.
Sandbox_DF_OpenKeybind_tooltip: LWJGL key code that opens the admin panel. Default 22 = U (paired with Shift). Common alternatives: 41 = backtick, 19 = R, 36 = J. Set to 0 to disable the keybind entirely.
Sandbox_DF_OpenKeyRequiresShift_tooltip: When enabled, the open key only fires while Shift is held. Recommended so the bind does not collide with single-key gameplay binds. Default Shift+U.
Sandbox_DF_MemoirDebug_tooltip: Print [MM_DBG] record / recall / dump traces from the Memoir system to the server and client logs. Leave off for normal play.
Sandbox_DF_MemoirXPRestore_tooltip: Global skill-XP restore percentage (100 = full restore, 90 = 10% off every skill, 0 = no XP). In Global mode this applies equally to every skill. In Per-Individual mode it is the fallback for any skill that has no per-skill value set (including modded skills). Traits, profession, recipes and ParanormalZ Faith always restore in full regardless of this setting. The normal recall never drops a skill below its current XP, so re-grinding still pays off.
Sandbox_DF_MemoirXPRestoreMode_tooltip: Global = the single XP restore % above applies to every skill. Per Individual = each skill uses its own % from the "Dragonfly: Memoir Skill XP" page (any skill left unset there falls back to the Global %). The per-skill sliders stay visible in both modes but only take effect in Per-Individual.
Sandbox_DF_ActionSpeedEnabled_tooltip: Master switch for timed-action speed scaling (default ON). Each family below picks a speed from Vanilla up to Instant. Inventory transfers are never scaled - in multiplayer the server completes them on vanilla timing, so speeding the client only makes the progress bar lie. Sandbox changes require a server restart.
Sandbox_DF_ASCleaning_tooltip: Cleaning blood, burns and graffiti; washing yourself and clothing.
Sandbox_DF_ASRepair_tooltip: Repairing clothing, vehicle engines and light bars.
Sandbox_DF_DebugGateEnabled_tooltip: When enabled (default), the admin/debug right-click options are hidden until you press the toggle key. Declutters the context menu. Disable to restore vanilla behaviour (debug options always shown to admins).
Sandbox_DF_DebugGateKey_tooltip: LWJGL key code that shows/hides the debug context options. Default 68 = F10 (unbound in vanilla B42). Other examples: 43 = backslash, 41 = backtick. Set to 0 to disable the toggle.
Sandbox_DF_DebugGateRequiresShift_toolti: When enabled, the toggle key only fires while Shift is held. Off by default, so the key works on its own.
Sandbox_DF_EngineLockEnabled_tooltip: When ON (default), non-admin players cannot 'Take Engine Parts' or uninstall the Engine from vehicles, stopping engine salvage that wrecks otherwise-good vehicles. Admins are unaffected. Client-side enforcement: it stops normal players but is not proof against modified clients.
Sandbox_DF_BanBoxEnabled_tooltip: Master switch for Dragonfly's item BanBox engine (default ON). When on, any item types registered by a ban-list mod (such as the optional BBLibrary submod, or your own) are stripped from loot distribution at server start so no new copies spawn. Prevention only - items already in the world are not removed. With no ban-list mod enabled the engine does nothing. Changes take effect on the next server restart.
Sandbox_DF_BanBoxConfiscateOnLogin_toolt: Default OFF. When on, a player connecting has any banned items removed from their CARRIED inventory (main, worn, and bags) - the one copy prevention can't reach. The player is told and an audit line is logged for staff; the player is never auto-punished. Bounded to the connecting player only - base storage, vehicles and the wider world are never touched. Requires the BanBox to be enabled above.
Sandbox_DF_BanBoxDebug_tooltip: Default OFF. Verbose BanBox tracing to the server log (login poll, per-player wait state, scan counts). Off keeps the log clean - only the confiscation audit line is still written. Turn on only when diagnosing the BanBox.
